page.overview:
Who is Byblos?

He appears as a guest during the battle against Serpentarius in the tenth and final floor of the Midlight's Deep secret dungeon. Unlike other guest characters, if Byblos is KO'd during this encounter, the countdown will appear, which can result in him being crystallized. If Byblos survives, he offers to join Ramza Beoulve's company, though it is never explained why.

Byblos's actual name is randomized, with Byblos being his monster species and job. Despite this, he does not gain JP and cannot learn new abilities.

Nothing is known about Byblos, including whether he was a servant of the Lucavi (like all Reavers) or rebelled against them. It is also unknown how he ended up inside Midlight's Deep; however, when Ramza and his allies reached the final level of the place and had to confront some Reavers led by Elidibus—a legendary wizard wielder of the secret thirteenth auracite who had been secluded there for many years—Byblos helped them defeat them. After the difficult battle, he offered to join Ramza's company.
